# HINJD Global

> Industrial ecosystem hub for aggregate and heavy equipment operators — AI diagnostics, fleet tracking, BeltSaver® predictive maintenance, CRM, and financial dashboards.

HINJD Global builds tools for mining, aggregates, and bulk material handling. Flagship products include BeltSaver® conveyor belt protection (U.S. Patent No. 12,195,281 B1), Cox Aggs aggregate operations, and Equipment Opps AI diagnostics.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the HINJD industrial ecosystem.
- [BeltSaver®](/beltsaver): Patented tail-pulley conveyor belt protection product.
- [Conveyor Maintenance](/conveyor-maintenance): B2B guide to reducing conveyor downtime.
- [Aggregate Opps](/aggregate-opps): Aggregate operations management tools.
- [Content Generator](/content-generator): AI content tooling for industrial brands.
- [Blog](/blog): Industry insights on conveyor maintenance and equipment diagnostics.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Privacy practices.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account authentication.
